OUTPUT_DIR = '/root/contamcal-irt-calibration/artifacts/random_mae_control'

def main():

    families = []

    for rid in respondent_ids:

        families.append(fam)

    raw_acc_full = responses.mean(axis=1)

    for i in range(N_models):
        if dosages[i] == 0:
            ground_truth[i] = raw_acc_full[i]

                      if dosages[j] == 0 and families[j] == families[i]]
            ground_truth[i] = raw_acc_full[d0_idx].mean()

    log.info('\nGround truth:')
    for fam in sorted(set(families)):
        d0_idx = [j for j in range(N_models) if dosages[j] == 0 and families[j] == fam]

    raw_mae_full = float(np.mean(np.abs(raw_acc_full - ground_truth)))

        resp_sub = responses[:, idx]
        raw_acc_sub = resp_sub.mean(axis=1)

            'N_models': int(N_models),

        fit = stan_model.sample(

            seed=seed, show_progress=False,
            show_console=False,
        )
        elapsed = time.time() - t0

        cal_mean = np.mean(fit.stan_variable('calibrated_score'), axis=0)

        try:

        except Exception:

        mae_cal = float(np.mean(np.abs(cal_mean - ground_truth)))
        mae_raw = float(np.mean(np.abs(raw_acc_sub - ground_truth)))
        tau_cal, p_cal = kendalltau(cal_mean, ground_truth)

        result = {
            'seed': seed,

        }

    mae_std = float(np.std(all_maes))
    tau_mean = float(np.mean(all_taus))
    tau_std = float(np.std(all_taus))

    output = {
        'experiment': 'random_300_item_mae_control',
        'benchmark': 'mmlu',
        'n_models': N_models,
        'n_items_total': N_items,
        'n_items_subset': N_SUBSET,

        'model_type': 'vanilla_2pl',

        'per_seed': seed_results,

        'respondents': [
            {'id': respondent_ids[i], 'family': str(families[i]), 'dosage': int(dosages[i]),
             'raw_acc_full': round(float(raw_acc_full[i]), 6),
             'ground_truth': round(float(ground_truth[i]), 6)}
            for i in range(N_models)
        ],
    }

    out_path = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, 'random_mae_control_results.json')
    with open(out_path, 'w') as f:
        json.dump(output, f, indent=2)
    log.info('Results saved to %s', out_path)

    print('\n' + '=' * 70)
    print('RANDOM 300-ITEM SUBSET MAE CONTROL (MMLU)')
    print('=' * 70)
    print(f'Models: {N_models} ({len(set(families))} families x 5 dosages)')
    print(f'Items: {N_items} total, {N_SUBSET} per subset')
    print(f'Seeds: {SEEDS}')
    print(f'Raw MAE (all {N_items} items): {raw_mae_full:.4f}')

    print(f'{"Seed":<6} {"MAE_cal":>8} {"MAE_raw":>8} {"tau":>8} {"Time":>6}')
    print('-' * 40)
    for r in seed_results:

    print('-' * 40)

if __name__ == '__main__':
